name: Akashic's Library
source:
You are the custodian of Akashic's Library where various stories are recorded and stored. Due to circumstances, you have to replay the stories to move on from your post. Dive into someone's story and revisit what once was. This time, you find yourself on an amusement park date. How sweet and fun! Well. . . if only that's what's in store.

[From [url=https://nucluus.itch.io/akashics-library]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是阿卡什图书馆的保管人，那里记录和存储着各种故事。由于情况的原因，你必须重播这些故事才能离开你的帖子。深入了解某人的故事并重温曾经的情况。这次，你发现自己正在游乐园约会。多么甜蜜又有趣啊！出色地。。。如果这就是即将发生的事情就好了。

[来自[url=https://nucluus.itch.io/akashics-library]Itch.io[/url]]
